messages.content: The current subject.mjs moves an interior end backward but never rejects an interior start, violating requirement 2. Fix: reject a start inside a surrogate pair.
messages.reasoning_content:
The subject.mjs seems to already satisfy the contract. Check requirements:

1. UTF-16 units — yes.
2. Reject interior start? Current code doesn't reject interior start (splitPair(offset) not checked). "reject an interior start and move an interior end backward" — code moves end backward but never rejects interior start. Need to add: if splitPair(offset) throw 'inspection-range-splits-unicode' (reject interior start). Current need(end>offset||offset===text.length...) rejects nonempty read not making progress but not interior start specifically. Interior start with max_chars: end=offset+max, then need(end>offset) passes since max>=1 — so interior start accepted. Fix: reject interior start.

Also allow empty slice exactly at EOF: offset===text.length fine.

Write replacement.
